test_item:
Generate CSR message.
(production: CSR exported through dealer mode)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. ADA Active Roles permit ADA+ protected data identifiers
3. The ECU serial number has been written
4. The CSR is generated at boot
proc:
1. <Dealer App access to the DUT provided by RD (X-k)> is executed
$ <command provided by RD (X-k)>
2. Run the OpenSSL signature check on the exported CSR on the host
$ openssl req -in ecu.crt -noout -verify
er:
1. <Dealer App access to the DUT provided by RD (X-k)>
2. The openssl command prints "verify OK" on stdout
